propositions: b690 enables req.config to influence Pass-1's effective model, exposing that plan-review.yaml declares trivial (haiku) when it should declare frontier (opus)

Pass-1 finder silently downgraded from opus to haiku on 2026-06-27 when _verifier_cfg landed, regressing from 115 recorded opus reviews to zero, but remained invisible because PydanticAIRunner.run discarded req.config until b690
plan-review.yaml model_ladder rung 0 must be frontier so Pass-1 generates findings on opus, while Pass-2 verify and Pass-4 coach remain on standard/sonnet per _verifier_cfg

prerequisite finder bin packing sizes against cfg.model, which post-b690 resolves to the model_ladder rung rather than the runner floor, requiring the rung to be frontier/opus to preserve the 1M window assumption

the effective model reaching Pass-1 at the ProductionBatchRunner→run_pass1→pass1_chunk seam must be asserted in tests to prevent future silent model downgrades, since YAML text alone cannot guarantee effective behavior
